request.description:
Create a manual account

AA accounts are created by ingestion, never through this endpoint; `source` is always `MANUAL`.
Get one account

Update an account

`label` and `institution` are editable on any account. `currentBalance`, `balanceAsOf` and
`card.creditLimit` are editable on `MANUAL` accounts only — on an AA account they return
`409 SOURCE_READ_ONLY`. Closed accounts return `409 ACCOUNT_CLOSED`.

Delete a manual account

Soft delete. AA accounts can't be deleted (`409 SOURCE_READ_ONLY`) — close them instead.

Close an account

Marks the account `CLOSED`. History is kept; it stops counting toward net worth. Closing an already-closed account is a no-op `200`.

query.description: `yyyy-MM`. Defaults to the current month in Asia/Kolkata.

request.description:
Monthly spending breakdown

Server-computed breakdown for one month: total spend, essential vs discretionary share, and
per-category amount + share. Excludes `SAVINGS_TRANSFER` and `excludedFromHabits` expenses
from spending totals (FINANCIAL_RULES §1.1); savings transfers are reported separately.

Latest Financial Health Score

Implements HEALTH_SCORE_SPEC.md §1. Always `200`: when fewer than 3 sub-scores are evaluated,
or no score has been computed yet, `band` is `INSUFFICIENT_DATA`, `overall` is absent and
`missingData` lists what to connect.

Health score trend

One point per bucket — the last score computed in it. Buckets with no score are omitted (no interpolation).

Current net worth

Computed on demand from open accounts, manual entries and the portfolio; nothing is stored, so the
figure is never stale. Loan and credit-card balances count as liabilities by magnitude. Closed
accounts are excluded. `breakdown` lists only non-empty buckets, assets first.

Record today's snapshot

Values net worth now and stores it as today's point in the trend (day boundaries are in
`Asia/Kolkata`), replacing an earlier snapshot from the same day. Safe to call repeatedly. Creating,
changing or deleting a manual item does this automatically.

Net worth trend

One point per bucket: the last snapshot in it. Buckets with no snapshot are omitted (no
interpolation). `change` is the movement from the first to the last point, computed by the server.
Returns `400` when `from` is after `to` or the range exceeds ten years.

request.description:
List insights

The caller's insights, most serious first (`CRITICAL`, `WARN`, `INFO`), newest first within a
severity (FINANCIAL_RULES §7 precedence). Defaults to `ACTIVE` ones. A rule has at most one
`ACTIVE` insight; when its finding changes the old one becomes `SUPERSEDED`.

Dismiss an insight

Hides the insight from the default list. Dismissing an already dismissed insight is a no-op `200`.
A dismissed insight stays dismissed while the finding is unchanged and comes back as a new
`ACTIVE` insight if the finding changes. A `SUPERSEDED` insight can't be dismissed
(`409 INSIGHT_SUPERSEDED`).

query.description: Only these states. Omit for all.

request.description:
List aggregator consents

The caller's Account Aggregator consents, newest first.

Request an aggregator consent

Starts a consent request at the Account Aggregator; the consent is `REQUESTED` until the user approves
it there and the client calls `activate`. Data is only ever fetched while a consent is `ACTIVE`.
Get one consent

Activate an approved consent

Called after the user approved the consent at the aggregator, with the consent artefact id it issued.
`REQUESTED` -> `ACTIVE`; any other state is `409 INVALID_CONSENT_STATE`. `422 AGGREGATOR_REJECTED` if
the aggregator does not confirm the approval.

Pause a consent

`ACTIVE` -> `PAUSED`; no fetch while paused. Any other state is `409 INVALID_CONSENT_STATE`.

Resume a paused consent

`PAUSED` -> `ACTIVE`. Any other state is `409 INVALID_CONSENT_STATE`.

Revoke a consent

Withdraws the consent at the aggregator. Already-imported data stays; no further fetch is possible.
Revoking a `REVOKED` or `EXPIRED` consent is `409 INVALID_CONSENT_STATE`.

Fetch data under a consent

Pulls data for the range (default: the consent's whole range), stores the raw payloads encrypted and
normalises them into events for the other modules. Idempotent per consent and range: repeating the call
returns the existing session with `200` instead of fetching again. An aggregator failure is recorded on
the session (`status: FAILED`, `error`) and still returns `202`. The body may be omitted.
`409 CONSENT_NOT_ACTIVE` unless the consent is `ACTIVE` and unexpired;
`422 FETCH_RANGE_INVALID` if the range is reversed or outside the consent's range.

request.description:
List fetch sessions

The caller's fetch sessions, newest first. Raw provider data is never exposed.

Get one fetch session

Includes the summary of its latest normalisation run, with counts of anything that could not be mapped.

Re-run normalisation for a fetch

Normalises the stored raw records again and republishes the events. Safe: every transaction carries a
stable `dedupKey`, so consumers do not double-count. Only a `COMPLETED` fetch (`409 FETCH_NOT_COMPLETED`)
whose raw records have not been purged.

item.name: Record a price for an instrument (admin only)

request.description:
Record a price for an instrument (admin only)

Manual price entry until a price feed exists. Quotes are shared by all users, so only users with the
ADMIN realm role may record one; everyone else receives 403. Quotes drive current
valuation of every holding in the instrument. `asOf` defaults to now; `422 QUOTE_IN_FUTURE` when
it is later than now.

request.description:
List holdings

Each holding carries its server-computed valuation. Closed (zero-quantity) holdings are left out unless `includeClosed=true`.

Record a holding manually

Origin is `MANUAL`. `quantity` must be above zero. `422 UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY` for an instrument
not priced in INR; `409 HOLDING_ALREADY_EXISTS` when the caller already has an open holding in the
instrument (update that one instead).
Get one holding

Update a holding

Send `quantity` and/or `avgCost`; at least one is required. A quantity of `0` closes the holding;
a positive quantity on a closed holding reopens it. `409 HOLDING_READ_ONLY` for holdings that were
not entered manually.

Delete a holding

Permanent. `409 HOLDING_READ_ONLY` for holdings that were not entered manually.

Portfolio totals and asset-class allocation

Server-computed over the caller's open INR holdings; the client displays these as returned.
`currentValue` counts only holdings that have a price; `unrealisedGain` only holdings with both a
price and a cost. Holdings in other currencies are counted in `excludedHoldingCount` until FX exists.
